name: Gothic Punk Lace-Up Look
name_es: Look gótico punk con shorts acordonados
swap_rule: Se cita el id. Se cambian color, material, grosor, transparencia, estampado y acabados. El corte no se reescribe.
top: Black cropped short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt, fitted at the waist, with a large white rectangular front graphic depicting a skeletal nun and the words BAD RELIGION; small silver safety pins along the sleeve edges
bottom: Very short fitted high-waisted black leather shorts with a deep V-shaped front waist opening, crisscross black cords across the opening, multiple vertical rows of silver eyelets and black lacing down the front and sides, with loose hanging lace ends
shoes: Knee-high fitted black leather boots with high heels, thick platform soles, front lacing through silver eyelets and buckled straps with silver hardware
accessories: Layered fine silver necklaces including a small cross pendant, small silver hoop earrings, a silver nostril hoop, silver rings and wide black leather wrist cuffs with silver buckles
nails: Short nails with dark plum-black polish

hair.style: Long loose hair with soft irregular waves, deep side part, one temple shaved in a pronounced sidecut, and a voluminous side-swept fringe partially covering one eye

makeup.eyeliner: Thick black eyeliner with long sharply extended wings and a defined lower lash line
makeup.lips: Deep plum-burgundy lipstick with a darker outline and matte finish

material: Cotton jersey, leather, black cord and silver-tone metal
estampado: White skeletal nun graphic and AXFRA lettering on the T-shirt
